changelog:
Initial release: Visual AI activity indicator with Philips Hue.

- Pulses Hue lights red when AI is thinking; turns green when done.
- Includes simple CLI commands to control light state (thinking, done, color changes, on/off).
- Uses local Hue Bridge API and works with any color bulb.
- Provides easy setup and workflow integration instructions.
- Stores configuration in user’s home directory for stateless, safe operation.
- Includes troubleshooting tips and future feature roadmap.
summary: Visual AI activity indicator using Philips Hue lights. Pulse red when thinking, green when done.
